# Data Preparation

## Loading library

```{r}
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(e1071)
library(class)
library(randomForest)
library(caret)
library(MLmetrics)
library(Metrics)
library(patchwork)
```

## Loading the dataset

```{r}
setwd("~/Desktop/UMass Workshop/Project") 

mydat <- st_read("final_df.geojson")
dim(mydat)
```

## Removing census tracts with invalid spatial coordinates

```{r}
table(st_is_valid(mydat))
analysis.dat <- mydat[st_is_valid(mydat),]
```

# Viewing the dataset

```{r}
View(analysis.dat)
```

# Collecting the column names

```{r}
ournames <- names(analysis.dat)[c(1:35,37,63:76,77:202,206,207, 226:228, 347:358, 376:379, 384:387, 392:395)]

newdata <- analysis.dat %>%
  select(all_of(ournames))

dim(newdata)
```

# See the var types

```{r}
glimpse(newdata)
```

# Replace "NULL" with NA in every character column

```{r}
newdata <- newdata %>%
  mutate(across(
    where(is.character),
    ~ na_if(., "NULL")
  ))
```

# Keep columns that has NA less than 50% 

```{r}
na_col <- colMeans(is.na(newdata)) * 100
cols_to_drop <- names(na_col[na_col > 50])

newdata <- newdata %>%
  select(-all_of(cols_to_drop))
```

# Changing the Median Family Income to numerical

```{r}
newdata <- newdata %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = MedianFamilyIncome,
      .fns  = ~ as.numeric(as.character(.))    
    )
  )
```

# Extracting the first 2 characters of the string, and changing the data from character to numeric of the column starts with "P_"

```{r}
newdata <- newdata %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      starts_with("T_"),        
      ~ as.double(str_sub(.x, 1, 2))
    )
  )
```

# Getting the column names

```{r}
newdata <- newdata %>%
  mutate(
    non_Pollution = rowMeans(across(all_of(non_cols))),
    d_Pollution   = rowMeans(across(all_of(d_cols))),
    p_Pollution   = rowMeans(across(all_of(p_cols))),
    b_Pollution   = rowMeans(across(all_of(b_cols))),
    t_Pollution   = rowMeans(across(all_of(t_cols)))
  )

newdata <- newdata %>%
  select(
    -all_of(non_cols),
    -all_of(d_cols),
    -all_of(p_cols),
    -all_of(b_cols),
    -all_of(t_cols)
  )         
```

# Delete all rows with at least one NA

```{r}
newdata <- newdata %>%
  filter(rowSums(is.na(.)) == 0)

glimpse(newdata)
```

# Dropping geometry variable & changing the class1 variable to factor

```{r}
newdata <- st_drop_geometry(newdata)
newdata <- newdata %>%
  mutate(class1 = as.factor(class1))
```

```{r}
keep_areas <- c(
  "Los Angeles-Long Beach, CA",
  "Boston-Cambridge-Newton, MA-NH",
  "New York-Newark-Jersey City, N"
)

newdata <- newdata %>%
  filter(cbsa_name %in% keep_areas)

table(newdata$cbsa_name)
```

# Splitting of training and testing

```{r}
set.seed(1234)
n <- nrow(newdata)
train_idx <- sample(n, size = 0.8 * n)

train <- newdata[train_idx, ]
test <- newdata[-train_idx, ]

train <- train %>%
  select(-formatGeoID, -geoid.x, -cbsa_name)

test <- test %>%
  select(-formatGeoID, -geoid.x, -cbsa_name)
```

# Running SVM Model with data

```{r}
model.svm <- svm(class1 ~ ., data = train, probability=TRUE)
pred_svm <- predict(model.svm, test)
```

# Running KNN Model with data

```{r}
train_x <- train[, setdiff(names(train), "class1")]
train_y <- train$class1

test_x <- test[, setdiff(names(test), "class1")]
test_y <- test$class1
```

```{r}
pred_knn <- knn(train = train_x, test = test_x, cl = train_y, k = 5)
```

# Running Random Forest Model with data

```{r}
model.rf <- randomForest(class1 ~ ., data = train)
pred_rf <- predict(model.rf, test)
```

# Getting the assessment metrics: overall accuracy, F1-score, Log-loss, Brier Score, and Sensitivity/Specificity for all models above

```{r}
# Accuracy
acc_svm <- mean(pred_svm == test$class1)
acc_knn <- mean(pred_knn == test_y)
acc_rf  <- mean(pred_rf  == test$class1)

# Table of metrics
results <- data.frame(
  model    = c("SVM", "KNN", "RF"),
  accuracy = c(acc_svm, acc_knn, acc_rf)
)
results
```

```{r}
# Obtain class‐probabilities for each model

# SVM 
prob_svm <- attr(
  predict(model.svm, test, probability = TRUE),
  "probabilities"
)

# Random forest
prob_rf <- predict(model.rf, test, type = "prob")

# KNN
knn3_mod <- knn3(class1 ~ ., data = train, k = 5)
prob_knn <- predict(knn3_mod, test)
```

```{r}
# Generate class predictions

# SVM & RF
pred_svm <- predict(model.svm, test)
pred_rf  <- predict(model.rf,  test)

# KNN: pick the class with highest probability
pred_knn <- factor(
  colnames(prob_knn)[apply(prob_knn, 1, which.max)],
  levels = levels(test$class1)
)
```

```{r}
# Confusion‐matrix metrics
cm_svm <- confusionMatrix(pred_svm, test$class1)
cm_rf  <- confusionMatrix(pred_rf,  test$class1)
cm_knn <- confusionMatrix(pred_knn, test$class1)

macro_avg <- function(cm, metric) {
  mean(cm$byClass[, metric], na.rm = TRUE)
}

metrics_df <- data.frame(
  Model       = c("SVM", "RF", "KNN"),
  Accuracy    = c(
    cm_svm$overall["Accuracy"],
    cm_rf$overall["Accuracy"],
    cm_knn$overall["Accuracy"]
  ),
  Sensitivity = c(
    macro_avg(cm_svm, "Sensitivity"),
    macro_avg(cm_rf,  "Sensitivity"),
    macro_avg(cm_knn, "Sensitivity")
  ),
  Specificity = c(
    macro_avg(cm_svm, "Specificity"),
    macro_avg(cm_rf,  "Specificity"),
    macro_avg(cm_knn, "Specificity")
  ),
  F1          = c(
    macro_avg(cm_svm, "F1"),
    macro_avg(cm_rf,  "F1"),
    macro_avg(cm_knn, "F1")
  )
)

print(metrics_df)
```


```{r}
# Define the manual multiclass Brier‐score function
brier_multiclass <- function(probs, truth) {
  y_mat <- model.matrix(~ truth + 0)
  colnames(y_mat) <- sub("^truth", "", colnames(y_mat))
  y_mat <- y_mat[, colnames(probs), drop = FALSE]
  mean(rowSums((probs - y_mat)^2))
}

# Compute Log‐loss for each model
LL_svm <- MultiLogLoss(y_pred = prob_svm, y_true = test$class1)
LL_rf  <- MultiLogLoss(y_pred = prob_rf,  y_true = test$class1)
LL_knn <- MultiLogLoss(y_pred = prob_knn, y_true = test$class1)

# Compute Brier Score for each model
BS_svm <- brier_multiclass(probs = prob_svm, truth = test$class1)
BS_rf  <- brier_multiclass(probs = prob_rf,  truth = test$class1)
BS_knn <- brier_multiclass(probs = prob_knn, truth = test$class1)

# Append to metrics_df 
metrics_df <- metrics_df %>%
  mutate(
    LogLoss    = c(LL_svm, LL_rf, LL_knn),
    BrierScore = c(BS_svm, BS_rf, BS_knn)
  )

print(metrics_df)
```

```{r}
predictions_df <- tibble(
  actual = test$class1,
  SVM    = pred_svm,
  RF     = pred_rf,
  KNN    = pred_knn
) %>%
  mutate(geoid.x = newdata$geoid.x[-train_idx])

head(predictions_df)
```

```{r}
# 1) Pull only the ID + geometry from your sf (analysis.dat):
geom_df <- analysis.dat[-train_idx, ] %>%
  select(geoid.x, lat, lon, cbsa_name)    # keep the real geometry list-column


la_indicator <- geom_df$cbsa_name == "Los Angeles-Long Beach, CA"
la_rows <- c(1:nrow(geom_df))[la_indicator]
# final_indicator <- intersect(la_rows, setdiff(1:nrow(newdata), train_idx))

# 2) Join onto your predictions and pivot long:
pred_sf <- geom_df[la_rows,] %>%
  select(-cbsa_name) %>%
  right_join(predictions_df[la_rows,], by = "geoid.x") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = actual:KNN,
    names_to  = "model",
    values_to = "grade"
  )

# 3) Now pred_sf is still an sf (with geometry)! Plot facet-grid:
ggplot(pred_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = grade)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "HOLC Grade", na.value = "grey90") +
  facet_grid(~model) +
  labs(title = "Actual vs. Predicted HOLC Grades") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    strip.text      = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
